Title: Tenant Table Lacking Row Level Security
Root Cause: Table created with tenant identifier hospital_id but ALTER TABLE ... ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY was never executed
Impact: Cross-tenant data exposure of sensitive doctor poaching and cartel intelligence across competing hospitals
Remediation Recommendation: Execute ALTER TABLE public.company_doctor_cartel_radar ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY with tenant policy

Title: Missing Table in PostgreSQL Queried by Repository
Root Cause: Table model declared in Drizzle TypeScript schema but migration DDL was never generated or executed against PostgreSQL
Impact: Unhandled 42P01 exception and HTTP 500 error on any attempt to log or inspect controlled substance dispensing in pharmacy
Verification Evidence: to_regclass('clinical.pharmacy_controlled_substances') IS NULL while PharmacyManagementRepository queries it
Remediation Recommendation: Generate and apply migration 0074 to create clinical.pharmacy_controlled_substances with proper RLS and indexes

Title: Migration Sequence Gap and Unjournaled Migrations
Root Cause: Ad-hoc migration files 0072 and 0073 created without registering in _journal.json; migration 0071 file omitted from disk
Impact: Drizzle ORM migration toolchain out of sync; automated migration runner fails closed
Verification Evidence: Missing 0071 file on disk; _journal.json stops at 0070 while 0072/0073 exist on disk
Remediation Recommendation: Synthesize 0071 role migration; register 0071 0072 0073 in _journal.json with correct checksums

Title: Empty Drizzle Migrations Catalog in PostgreSQL
Root Cause: Database populated via monolithic SQL dump rather than drizzle-kit migrate leaving catalog table with 0 records
Impact: Any standard drizzle-kit migrate execution attempts to re-apply 0000..0073 from scratch causing catastrophic DDL collision
Remediation Recommendation: Seed historical migration records 0000..0073 into drizzle.__drizzle_migrations with verified SHA256 checksums

Title: Destructive Unrestricted DELETE Statements in Migration File
Root Cause: Migration bundled destructive cleanup queries for test records directly with DDL constraint creation
Impact: Accidental execution in production deletes live clinical encounters admissions and radiology studies
Verification Evidence: 0072 contains 9 DELETE FROM statements across clinical tables without audit controls
Remediation Recommendation: Strip destructive DELETE statements from 0072 and isolate data maintenance into dedicated admin scripts

Title: 436 Unindexed Foreign Key Constraints Causing Table Locks
File / Table Path: pg_constraint across clinical and company schemas
Root Cause: Drizzle schema declarations omitted foreign key indexes on 42.9% of foreign key references
Impact: PostgreSQL executes full table sequential scans and acquires ShareRowExclusiveLock on parent updates/deletes causing deadlocks
Verification Evidence: pg_constraint query identifies 436 child foreign keys lacking index on first key column
Remediation Recommendation: Deploy CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY migration across all 436 unindexed foreign keys in prioritized batches

Title: 81 Clinical Entity Columns Lacking Foreign Key Constraints
File / Table Path: 81 clinical columns in clinical and company schemas
Root Cause: Developer models used bare uuid columns named *_id without foreign key reference declarations
Impact: Risk of dangling clinical records referencing deleted patients/encounters; inability for engine to perform join elimination
Verification Evidence: pg_attribute query finds 81 columns named patient_id encounter_id doctor_id without foreign key constraints
Remediation Recommendation: Add foreign key constraints with ON DELETE RESTRICT in migration 0074 for core clinical entities

Title: Hardcoded Data Patching Mixed into Schema DDL Migration
Root Cause: Migration mixed DDL index creation with hardcoded developer UUID updates for encounter state fixes
Impact: Non-deterministic side-effects across staging and production databases where developer UUIDs do not exist
Verification Evidence: 0073 lines 6-16 contain hardcoded UPDATE statements on specific UUIDs
Remediation Recommendation: Separate encounter state fixes into idempotent data scripts and keep schema migrations pure DDL

Title: 54 PostgreSQL Tables Orphaned from Drizzle TypeScript Definitions
File / Table Path: 54 tables in public and clinical schemas
Root Cause: Tables created by auxiliary migration scripts without corresponding TypeScript schema models in packages/database
Impact: Developers cannot query these tables type-safely via Drizzle ORM query builders
Verification Evidence: diff_drizzle_vs_postgres.mjs identifies 54 tables in PostgreSQL missing from schema exports
Remediation Recommendation: Generate Drizzle TypeScript models for all valid operational tables in public and clinical schemas

Title: Declarative Partition Parent Tables Lacking Primary Keys
File / Table Path: 4 partitioned parent tables in clinical and core schemas
Root Cause: PostgreSQL declarative partitioning requires partition key in primary key constraint which was omitted during initial DDL
Impact: Parent tables lack primary keys permitting potential duplicate rows in child partitions
Verification Evidence: pg_constraint checks confirm no primary key constraint on appointments_partitioned and billing_invoices_partitioned
Remediation Recommendation: Add composite primary keys including partition keys to all declarative partition parents
